subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's six-source internal inter-session orphan drop rule after real embedded-runner proof, or should the fix be narrowed or deferred to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The code path changes model-visible prompt and active transcript repair semantics, and tests/CI do not prove the real runtime split between internal handoffs and user-directed `sessions_send` input.

options.title: Require real proof for this predicate
options.body: Ask for redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording showing internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` remains preserved before deciding merge.

options.title: Narrow before proof
options.body: If all six internal source tools are not known-safe to drop, narrow the predicate first and then require proof for the smaller scope.

options.title: Prefer the broader sibling repair
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 to own the canonical issue's session-repair semantics.

recommendation.title: Require real proof for this predicate
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording showing internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` remains preserved before deciding merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the current prompt helper and subagent completion handoff surface in recent history.
